item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: a set bedtime and a relaxation practice before it. That's the right structure, so protect it. Keep the last hour calm, with no problem-solving and no check-ins that stir things up. Sleep is when your mind sorts the day, so you don't need to settle everything before bed. Tonight, start your muscle relaxation on time and put the phone down when it ends.
